description: Get the full post-race ML analytics bundle for a race. Includes per-driver per-lap outputs: pit stop probability, safety car probability, overtake probability, undercut probability, tyre health, cliff risk and lap prediction, fuel-corrected lap time (LTOE), win probability, expected championship points. Also includes pit stops, tyre stints, lap times, and safety-car lap list. No authentication required.
name: get_race_insights
